entries.rationale: Accept concise conventional noun for summary tab; overview spans colony, food, work and defence.
Accept established exact [Economy] glossary target; this tab groups labour, materials and buildings.
Accept short neutral game-world noun; this topic includes map/score and win-chance information, so नकाशा alone would narrow the source.
Accept clear parallel nouns for idle workers and blocked construction section; avoid treating construction as an imperative.
Accept exact existing [Defense] anchor; section contains warriors and intruders.
Accept and reuse exact existing [view history] target. Action wording is suitable for chart accessible text; avoids unnecessary spelling/style drift.
Prefer neutral status wording without the implied first-person/computer subject of वाट पाहत आहे. Keeps ongoing wait and exact ellipsis, without promising an arrival time or declaring an error.

Add natural Marathi genitive instead of a bare noun stack; keeps established युनिट and तपशील. This expands colony-wide counts, availability, needs and abilities rather than describing only a selected soldier.
Accept ordinary concise selector/category label. No current C++ consumer found for this new catalog label, so no invented UI behavior asserted.
Accept clear imperative for the expanded history dialog, distinct from the short view-history action.

entries.rationale: Clarify that the missing item is a recorded measurement and that the user selects one statistics item/metric. Raw आकडेवारी निवडा reads like selecting the entire collective statistics panel. Preserve initial unknown-reading dash and details action; no fabricated loading/error/correctness claim.
Accept natural lush-green appearance descriptor; French Herbe luxuriante confirms adjective. Same Grass mechanics, no added fertility promise.
Accept concise standard dry-grass noun phrase; French Herbe sèche agrees. Avoid adding a dead-grass mechanic absent from this cosmetic appearance.

Correct semantic head: source labels sand associated with dunes, not countable piles. French Sable de dune and G::Sand authored appearance confirm the material interpretation. Uses plain Marathi rather than an obscure coined compound; deliberately avoids adding a desert-location assumption. Full phrase may wrap naturally in the brush label.
Accept simple color descriptor, confirmed by French Sable clair; retains material head वाळू without implying altered sand physics.

Prefer natural location/genitive phrase over bare noun stacking; preserve established आच्छादन glossary and plural. Actual header groups starving/damage/defence/fertility map toggles, not graph history.
